rules.name: React Component Development
rules.description: Guidelines for creating and modifying React components
rules: Always use TypeScript with strict typing - no 'any' types
Create components in src/components/ directory
Co-locate CSS files with components (e.g., Component.tsx with Component.css)
Use React hooks (useState, useMemo, useCallback) appropriately
Export components as named exports, not default exports
Add proper JSDoc comments for component props
Implement accessibility features (ARIA labels, semantic HTML)
Use consistent component naming conventions

rules.name: TypeScript Usage
rules.description: TypeScript best practices for this project
rules: Define all data structures in src/types/ directory
Use interfaces over types for object definitions
Avoid any implicit types - use explicit typing
Import types using 'import type' for better tree-shaking
Maintain strict mode in tsconfig.json
Use union types for variant data

rules.name: Styling Standards
rules: Primary gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)
Background gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f7fa 0%, #c3cfe2 100%)
Use consistent spacing: 0.5rem, 1rem, 1.5rem, 2rem, 3rem
Box shadow for depth: 0 8px 32px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.2)
Smooth transitions: transition: all 0.3s ease
Mobile breakpoint: 768px
Use flexbox for layouts
Maintain color consistency: #333 for dark text, #999 for light

rules.name: Data Management
rules: Employee data stored in src/data/employees.json
Each employee must have: id, rank, name, avatar, jobPosition, totalScore, year, quarter, activities
Activities include: id, activity, category, date, points
Use useMemo for filtering operations in Leaderboard component
Maintain sorting by rank property

rules.name: Feature Implementation
rules: Filtering: Extend FilterOptions in types, add form field, implement filter logic
New component: Create .tsx file, create .css file, export named component
New employee: Add to employees.json maintaining interface structure
New activity category: Add to employee activities, update styling in EmployeeRow.css
